test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

I don’t get on with the new boss, so I __have asked to transferring__ to another branch of the company.

options.text: will have ask to be transfer
have been ask to be transferring

solution:
The correct answer is **"have asked to be transferred"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Let's see the correct sentence formation:

__
 
• I don’t get on with the new boss, so I*** have asked to be transferred ***to another branch of the company.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's how the correct sentence formation happens:

 
• It should be** ****have asked to be transferred** instead of **have asked to transferring**
 
• Grammatically speaking,** "be"** is an auxiliary verb, and** "to be" **is its infinitive format.
 
• Regarding the meaning, both kind of mean the same.
 
• They can both convey the existence or occurrence of something, possessing a quality, or just simply show a particular tense without having an independent meaning.
 
• Talking about** "ed"** and **"ing" **in the words **"transferred"** and **transferring"**
 
• Adjectives ending in **-ed** show what has happened to a person or thing.
 
• Adjectives ending in **-ing** show the effect which something has on a person or thing.
